message:
Three languages, a first-run guided tour, and the bugs found running it

LANGUAGE. English, বাংলা and हिन्दी, switchable at any time. The English
string is the key, so untranslated text falls back to English rather than
showing a raw identifier. Bebas Neue and Hanken Grotesk carry no Bengali or
Devanagari glyphs at all, so Noto Sans Bengali and Devanagari are bundled and
wired in as fontFamilyFallback — without them a translated build renders as
empty boxes. Longer translations now shrink to fit instead of overflowing
their buttons, nav labels and segments. The picker appears once on first
launch, written in all three scripts, because someone who reads only Bengali
cannot navigate an English menu to find the language setting; it also lives
in the profile permanently, and travels with the cloud save.

TUTORIAL. A spotlight, a pointing hand and a caption walk a new player
through every screen, into a real match, across every control, and out the
far side of the results card — 29 steps, once, on a genuinely fresh install.
A profile restored from a backup code is marked as already taught. It sets
SMG, CASUAL and the medic hero first, so the first match is winnable. Targets
scroll themselves into view, and a target that is off-screen degrades to a
plain NEXT: being unable to continue is the one failure a tutorial must never
have. Skip appears after three steps behind a confirmation, and REPLAY
TUTORIAL sits in the profile.

Bugs found on the way:
- A rounded box cannot carry a border with one coloured side. Flutter asserts
  and ABANDONS painting the rest of the enclosing stack, which is what turned
  the whole app into a blank screen. Three of these existed; all are now
  clipped accent strips.
- Dying never cleared , so the bots fought on under the results card
  and you kept hearing gunfire over your own summary.
- SHARE encoded the PNG after the tap. The results screen now pre-warms it on
  open, so the sheet opens immediately.
- The splash logo was an opaque black square, cropped at the shield's point.
  It is transparent now, with room around the mark.
